name: Command Aliases
description:
Create your own short commands and hotkeys from an in-game menu, so you never have to type long commands again. Open the menu with the K key (you can rebind it in Controls) or by typing /aliases.

QUICK COMMANDS: Turn any command into a shortcut. For example, make /s run /gamemode survival @s. Start a shortcut with / to type it as a command, or with ! or ? to type it in chat (like !s or ?s). Shortcuts are not case sensitive, so /S and /s both work. Extra words you type are added to the end (/s Steve runs /gamemode survival @s Steve), or placed exactly where you write {args}. You can chain several commands in one shortcut by separating them with ;

HOTKEYS: Pick any key and choose what it runs when you press it in game. A hotkey can run a normal command or one of your quick commands.

Everything saves automatically in your config folder and stays until you remove it. Every shortcut and hotkey can be switched ON or OFF, edited, removed, or dragged up and down to put them in any order you like. Client-side only, so it works on any server without the server needing the mod.
